description: DELETE a location board permanently. There is no undo and no soft-archive — the row is removed. Images and clips that were generated with this `location_id` keep their already-rendered prompt, but the board they point at is gone: nothing can be re-anchored to it, and lab_get_location will 404. Confirm with the user before calling this. Use lab_restyle_location if you only want the place to look different.

loc_id.description: Location board id to delete permanently (from lab_list_locations)

name: lab_delete_location
title: Delete Location
